open_points.subject: Contract authoring check order (A01 vs A02)
open_points.text: A01 rule 5: "This check comes first among the operation's own checks..."; A02 rule 1: "When several conditions fail, the first in this list is named."
open_points.question: If a first contract for a new slot is missing purpose and also fails an A02 contract condition, which refusal must be returned first?
options: Always refuse missing purpose first (A01 precedence)
Apply A02 list first and report its first failure
Different order for create-slot vs existing-slot requests
open_points.default_guess: Always run the A01 purpose check first, then A02 validations.

open_points.subject: Flow composition check order (A01 vs A05)
open_points.text: A01 rule 5: "[purpose] check comes first among the operation's own checks"; A05 rule 7: "Composition refuses... a flow version whose node ids repeat... the first of these, in this order, is named."
open_points.question: When composing the first version of a new flow, if purpose is missing and structural faults also exist, which failure is reported?
open_points.default_guess: Missing purpose first, then A05 structural pre-proof checks.

open_points.subject: Resume behavior when a previously unreachable element can no longer send
open_points.text: A14 rule 2: "Resume... sends again... every element waiting on service_unreachable..." and "an element whose grant was revoked meanwhile waits for approval instead."
open_points.question: During one resume call, if an earlier service_unreachable element now switches to owner_approval (no valid authority), must resume continue processing later service_unreachable elements or stop immediately?
options: Continue scanning all service_unreachable elements in order
Stop at first element that cannot be resent
open_points.default_guess: Continue through all eligible elements, converting some to owner_approval as needed.

open_points.subject: Meaning of A13 rule 5 for service_unreachable waits
open_points.text: A13 rule 5: "`service_unreachable` and `outcome_unknown` are waits... until the owner's resolution makes the element count as succeeded or failed (A11 rule 3)."
open_points.question: Does 'owner's resolution' apply only to outcome_unknown, or also to service_unreachable elements?
options: Only outcome_unknown is owner-resolved; service_unreachable is resolved by retry/resume
Both wait reasons require owner resolution
Service_unreachable may be resolved either way
open_points.default_guess: Owner resolution applies only to outcome_unknown; service_unreachable changes only via resume retry outcome.

open_points.subject: Pre-send instance-header duplication check location/status
open_points.text: A08 rule 5 includes refusal when instance "names one required header twice"; A08 rule 6 excludes instance checks from binding_stale; A09 rule 6 pre-send list does not explicitly name this case; A10 rule 1 mentions `required_header_repeated` as an instance-check detail.
open_points.question: At send time (including read operations), if required headers are duplicated in the selected instance, which exact pre-send failure path is normative?
options: A09 pre-send `operation_failed` with detail `required_header_repeated` for all operation classes
Refuse only at propose/accept time, undefined at send time
open_points.default_guess: Handle as A09 pre-send failure (`operation_failed`, detail `required_header_repeated`) and do not send.
